description: This file defines a Flutter widget 'PaymentMethodSheet' that provides a bottom sheet UI for selecting among different payment options like Paytm, Google Pay, PhonePe, and Cash. It allows users to open external payment apps via deep links and handles the case where the app is not installed.

classes.name: PaymentMethodSheet
classes.description: A Flutter StatelessWidget that displays a bottom sheet with various payment options and handles launching external payment apps via deep links.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the payment method sheet, including UI elements for each payment option.

methods.name: _buildPaymentOption
methods.description: Creates a ListTile widget representing a payment option with an icon, name, and tap handler.

methods.name: _launchPaymentApp
methods.description: Attempts to launch an external payment app using a URL scheme; shows a snack bar if the app is not installed.
